hero.roles: Fullstack Developer Focused on Frontend / Graphic Designer
summary: I'm a developer who builds interactive web experiences with TypeScript and React, along with robust APIs developed with Java and Spring Boot. I have hands-on experience merging software development with my graphic design training, which lets me integrate composition, visual identity and user experience into the creation process, aiming for a balance between aesthetics, usability and technical quality. My profile is complemented by data persistence with Hibernate and JPA, databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, plus essential tools like Docker and GitHub.
I hold two professional degrees: Higher University Technician (TSU) in Computer Science and Graphic Designer. I keep training myself and acquiring new knowledge on my own.
hero.sceneAlt: elicatari illustration: astronaut panda coding in space

about.title: About me
about.path: My path didn't start among lines of code, but exploring visual communication as a graphic designer. Over time, curiosity about how everything worked on the inside led me into computing and software development. Today I don't see design and code as separate fields, but as two sides of the same solution.
about.mascot: And that mascot? If you're wondering about the little panda that lives in this portfolio, his name is Pandiux. He was born from a play on words between pandas, user experience (UI/UX), and the free software GNU/Linux. He's the official mascot of my digital space.
about.elibits: One more curiosity... Did you find the EliBits easter egg? It's the identity I use for independent technical consulting, specialized support, and software development.
